name: moving-checklist
description:
Produces a comprehensive 8-week moving timeline and checklist covering
decluttering, hiring movers, utilities transfer, address changes, packing
strategy, moving day protocol, and first week tasks in the new home.
Generates phase-based task lists with specific deadlines and responsible
party assignments for household relocations.
Use when the user asks about planning a move, creating a moving checklist,
or organizing a household relocation.
Do NOT use for moving with children specifically (use moving-with-children),
international relocation (visa and customs requirements are outside scope),
or commercial office moves.
